sloka: स्निग्धो धर्मरतो वीरस्सततम् सत्पथे स्थितः ।प्रियः प्राणसमो वशो भ्राता चापि सखा च मे ॥२-३१-१०॥
transliteration: snigdho dharmarato vīrassatatam satpathe sthitaḥ ।priyaḥ prāṇasamo vaśo bhrātā cāpi sakhā ca me ॥2-31-10॥

translations.english: You are affectionate, you are devoted to dharma. You are valiant. You always walk the path of virtue. You are dear to me like my own life. You are not only an obedient brother but also a friend.
